# Full-lifetime duration weights in seconds for self-host e2e sharding.
# Refreshed with scripts/ci-test-weights from CI runs 42348301476 (45420b1d)
# and 42350704451 (06732fe4), whose self-host jobs and verify jobs were green.
# Each observed row is ceil(the slower measurement). Lowering requires two
# distinct runs. Unobserved rows retain their old weight; one-second rows
# use the partitioner's default. Every live test remains selected once.
#
# Replay over the same two runs, all 4,213 measured tests: the largest summed
# x86 shard load goes from 3541 s to 3325 s and from 4090 s to 3817 s. No
# independent run existed yet, so live CI confirms the balance.
# These are offline sums of measured per-test times, not new live wall times.
# Ten x86 shards, two aarch64 shards, four workers and all deadlines stay
# unchanged.
# Evidence: docs/ci-log/2026-11-07-self-host-weight-refresh.md.
